harrat-mujtaba:1-1.t: «كتاب»: the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "this is a Book". The interpreted maṣdar «لتخرج» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أنزلناه». The preposition and its genitive noun «بإذن» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «تخرج», i.e. "accompanied by the permission". The preposition and its genitive noun «إلى صراط» is a badal (substitute) from «إلى النور»; «الحميد»: a badal.

harrat-mujtaba:2-2.t: «الله الذي»: a badal (substitute) from {الْحَمِيدِ}, and the relative is its naʿt (adjective). The preposition and its genitive noun «له» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject), the relative; «ما في السماوات»: attached to the implied ṣila (relative clause). The clause «له ما في السماوات» is the ṣila of the nominal relative. «وويل»: the wāw is resumptive; «ويل» is a mubtadaʾ, and the preposition and its genitive noun is attached to the khabar.

harrat-mujtaba:3-3.t: «الذين» is a relative, the mubtadaʾ (subject); its khabar (predicate) is the clause «أولئك في ضلال».

harrat-mujtaba:4-4.t: «من رسول»: a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and «من» is redundant (zāʾida); «إلا» is for restriction, and the preposition and its genitive noun «بلسان» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أرسلنا». The clause «فيُضِلُّ» is resumptive, and likewise the clause «وهو العزيز».

harrat-mujtaba:5-5.t: The clause «ولقد أرسلنا موسى» is resumptive, and the clause «لقد أرسلنا» is the answer to the oath. The preposition and its genitive noun «بآياتنا» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «موسى», i.e. "accompanied". «أن» is explicative, and the clause «أخرج» is explicative. The preposition and its genitive noun «لكل» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «آيات».

harrat-mujtaba:6-6.t: «وإذ قال»: the wāw is resumptive; «إذ» is an adverbial noun, the object of an implied «اذكر». The preposition and its genitive noun «عليكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «نعمة». «إذ أنجاكم»: an adverbial noun, a badal (substitute) of inclusion (badal ishtimāl) from «نعمة». The clause «يسومونكم» is a ḥāl from «آل فرعون», and the clause «وفي ذلكم بلاء» is conjoined to the content of the speech (maqūl al-qawl).

harrat-mujtaba:7-7.t: «وإذ تأذَّن»: the wāw is a conjunction; «إذ» is an adverbial noun conjoined to the clause «إذ أنجاكم», and the clause «تأذَّن» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The clause «لئن شكرتم لأزيدنَّكم» is explicative of the proclaiming, which carries the meaning of saying without its letters. The clause «لأزيدنكم» is the answer to the oath, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by the answer to the oath. The clause «ولئن كفرتم» is conjoined to «لئن شكرتم», and the clause «إن عذابي لشديد» is the answer to the second oath; the apodosis is omitted, indicated by the answer to the oath.

harrat-mujtaba:8-8.t: «أنتم» is a tawkīd (emphasis) of the wāw in «تكفروا», with no grammatical position. «من» is a relative conjoined to the wāw; conjoining an overt noun to an attached nominative pronoun is permitted because of the separating element. The preposition and its genitive noun is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied ṣila (relative clause), and «جميعا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the latent (mustatir) pronoun in the implied ṣila.

harrat-mujtaba:9-9.t: The preposition and its genitive noun «من قبلكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied ṣila (relative clause); «قوم» is a badal (substitute) from «الذين». The clause «والذين من بعدهم لا يعلمهم إلا الله» is conjoined to the resumptive clause «ألم يأتكم نبأ», and the clause «لا يعلمهم إلا الله» is the khabar (predicate) of «الذين». The clause «جاءتهم» is explicative of «النبأ», and the clause «فردُّوا» is conjoined to the clause «جاءتهم». «لفي»: the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa). The preposition and its genitive noun «مما» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «شك», and «مريب» is a second naʿt of «شك».

harrat-mujtaba:10-10.t: «شك» is a delayed mubtadaʾ (subject); «فاطر» is a badal (substitute), and a badal with a derived word is rare. The clause «يدعوكم» is resumptive within the scope of the speech. «إن» is negating, «أنتم» is the mubtadaʾ, «إلا» is for restriction, and «بشر» is the khabar (predicate); «مثلنا» is a naʿt (adjective) of «بشر», and the clause «تريدون» is a second naʿt of «بشر». The clause «فأتونا» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition, i.e. "if you are messengers, then bring us…", in the position of a jussive.

harrat-mujtaba:11-11.t: The clause «ولكن الله يمنّ» is conjoined to the content of the speech (maqūl al-qawl). «وما كان لنا أن نأتيكم»: the preposition and its genitive noun «لنا» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied khabar (predicate) of «كان», and the maṣdar «أن نأتيكم» is the noun of «كان»; the preposition and its genitive noun «بإذن» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «نأتيكم», and «إلا» is for restriction. The clause «وما كان لنا أن نأتيكم» is conjoined to the content of the speech. «وعلى الله فليتوكل»: the wāw is resumptive, and the preposition and its genitive noun is attached to «يتوكل»; the fāʾ is redundant (zāʾida), and the lām is the jussive lām of command.

harrat-mujtaba:12-12.t: «وما لنا ألا نتوكل»: the wāw is a conjunction; «ما» is an interrogative noun, the mubtadaʾ (subject), and the preposition and its genitive noun is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate); the interpreted maṣdar is accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e. "in abandoning reliance". The clause «وقد هدانا سبلنا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «نتوكل». The clause «ولنصبرنَّ على ما آذيتمونا» is resumptive, and the clause «ولنصبرنَّ» is the answer to the oath. The fāʾ in «فليتوكل» is redundant (zāʾida).

harrat-mujtaba:13-13.t: The clause «لنخرجنَّكم» is the answer to an oath, and the oath with its answer is the content of the speech (maqūl al-qawl). «لتعودُنَّ»: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, which has been omitted because of a succession of similar letters; the implied wāw is the fāʿil (agent), omitted because of the meeting of two sukūns. The clause «لنهلكن» is the answer to an implied oath, and the oath with its answer is a clause explicative of the revelation, with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:14-14.t: The clause «ولنسكننكم» is conjoined to the clause «نهلكنّ», and the clause «ذلك لمن خاف» is resumptive. «وعيد»: a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb) with an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the letter before the omitted yāʾ.

harrat-mujtaba:15-15.t: The clause «واستفتحوا» is conjoined to the preceding clause «أوحى», with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:16-16.t: The clause «من ورائه جهنم» is a naʿt (adjective) of «جبار», and the clause «يسقى» is conjoined to the clause «من ورائه جهنم».

harrat-mujtaba:17-17.t: The clause «يتجرعه» is a naʿt (adjective) of «ماء». «وما هو بميت»: the wāw is circumstantial, and the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the hāʾ in «يأتيه»; «ما» is negating, operating like «ليس», and the bāʾ in its khabar (predicate) is redundant (zāʾida). The clause «ومن ورائه عذاب» is conjoined to the clause «يأتيه الموت».

harrat-mujtaba:18-18.t: «أعمالهم كرماد»: a second mubtadaʾ (subject), and the preposition and its genitive noun is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of the second mubtadaʾ. The preposition and its genitive noun «مما» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «شيء». The clause «أعمالهم كرماد» is the khabar of «مَثَلُ», and it needs no link because the predicate clause is the mubtadaʾ itself in meaning. The clause «اشتدت» is a naʿt (adjective) of «رماد», and the clause «لا يقدرون» is a ḥāl from the fāʿil (agent) of «كفروا». «هو الضلال»: «هو» is a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl) with no grammatical position, and «الضلال» is the khabar of «ذلك».

harrat-mujtaba:19-19.t: The interpreted maṣdar made from «أن» and what follows it takes the place of the two objects of «تر». The preposition and its genitive noun «بالحق» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «خلق». The conditional clause is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:20-20.t: The bāʾ in «بعزيز» is redundant (zāʾida), and «عزيز» is the khabar (predicate) of «ما», which operates like «ليس»; the clause is conjoined to the clause {إِنْ يَشَأْ}.

harrat-mujtaba:21-21.t: «جميعا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the wāw in «برزوا». The preposition and its genitive noun «لكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl from «تبعا». The clause «فهل أنتم مغنون» is conjoined to the clause that is the content of the speech (maqūl al-qawl); the preposition and its genitive noun «عنا» is attached to the khabar (predicate) «مغنون»; the preposition and its genitive noun «من عذاب» is attached to a ḥāl from «شيء», and «شيء» stands in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), with «من» redundant (zāʾida), i.e. "any availing, little or much". «سواء»: a fronted khabar, and the preposition and its genitive noun «علينا» is attached to the maṣdar «سواء». The hamza is the hamza of equalization (taswiya), and what follows it, being interpretable as a maṣdar, is a delayed mubtadaʾ (subject); «أم» is a conjunction. The clause «أجزعنا أم صبرنا» is resumptive within the scope of the speech, and the clause «ما لنا من محيص» is resumptive within the scope of the speech; «محيص» is a mubtadaʾ, and «من» is redundant.

harrat-mujtaba:22-22.t: The clause «لما قضي الأمر» is parenthetical between the saying and what is said; «لما» is a particle of "occurrence upon occurrence", and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it. «وعد الحق»: a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). The clause «وما كان لي عليكم من سلطان» is conjoined to the content of the speech (maqūl al-qawl); the preposition and its genitive noun «لي» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of «كان»; «عليكم» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «سلطان»; «سلطان» is the noun of «كان», and «من» is redundant (zāʾida). «إلا أن دعوتكم»: «إلا» is for exception, «أن» is maṣdar-forming, and the interpreted maṣdar is accusative as a disconnected exception (istithnāʾ munqaṭiʿ), because his calling is not of the kind of clear proof. The clause «فلا تلوموني» is resumptive within the scope of the speech. «ما أنا بمصرخكم»: «ما» is negating, operating like «ليس», and the bāʾ in its khabar is redundant; the clause is resumptive within the scope of the speech, and likewise the clause «إني كفرت». «أشركتمون»: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn; the tāʾ is the fāʿil (agent), the mīm is for the plural, the wāw is for lengthening (ishbāʿ), the nūn is the nūn of protection (wiqāya), and the omitted yāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause «لهم عذاب» is the khabar of «إن».

harrat-mujtaba:23-23.t: «جنات» is a second mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «خالدين» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the relative, and the preposition and its genitive noun is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «خالدين». The preposition and its genitive noun «بإذن» is attached to a ḥāl from the latent (mustatir) pronoun in «خالدين». The clause «تحيتهم فيها سلام» is a ḥāl from the relative; the preposition and its genitive noun «فيها» is attached to a ḥāl from «تحيتهم», and «سلام» is the khabar (predicate) of «تحيتهم».

harrat-mujtaba:24-24.t: The clause «كيف ضرب» is the object of «تَرَ», whose operation is suspended (muʿallaq) by the interrogative, and the clause «أصلها ثابت» is a naʿt (adjective) of «شجرة».

harrat-mujtaba:25-25.t: The clause «تؤتي» is a naʿt (adjective) of «شجرة». «كل حين»: a ẓarf (adverb) of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) «تؤتي». The clause «ويضرب» is resumptive, and the clause «لعلهم يتذكرون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:26-26.t: The preposition and its genitive noun «كشجرة» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject). The clause «اجتثت» is a naʿt (adjective) of «شجرة», and the clause «ما لها من قرار» is a second naʿt of «شجرة»; «قرار» is a mubtadaʾ, and «من» is redundant (zāʾida).

harrat-mujtaba:27-27.t: The two prepositional phrases «بالقول» and «في الحياة» are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يثبت», and the clause «ويضل» is conjoined to the clause «يثبت».

harrat-mujtaba:28-28.t: The two objects of «بدَّلوا» are «نعمت» and «كفرا», and the two objects of «أحَلُّوا» are «قومهم» and «دار».

harrat-mujtaba:29-29.t: «جهنم» is a badal (substitute) from {دَارَ الْبَوَارِ}, and the clause «يصلونها» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «جهنم». The one specified for blame (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-dhamm) is omitted, i.e. «جهنم», and the clause of blame is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:30-30.t: The preposition and its genitive noun «لله» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the second object of «جعل», and the clause «فإن مصيركم» is conjoined to «تمتعوا».

harrat-mujtaba:31-31.t: «يقيموا»: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), because it falls in the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition, i.e. "if you say to them, they will establish". If it is said: his saying to them "establish" does not necessitate that they do it, it is replied: what is meant by "servants" is the believers, and whenever he commands them they comply. «سرا»: a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the wāw in «ينفقوا». The maṣdar «أن يأتي» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The clause «لا بيع فيه» is a naʿt (adjective) of «يوم»; «لا» is negating, operating like «ليس», and «بيع» is its noun.

harrat-mujtaba:32-32.t: «الله الذي»: mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate), and the clause is resumptive. The preposition and its genitive noun «من الثمرات» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «رزقا»; the preposition and its genitive noun «لكم» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «رزقًا».

harrat-mujtaba:34-34.t: «ما» is a relative, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the second object of «آتاكم» is omitted, i.e. "something". The clause «وإن تعدُّوا» is resumptive; «كَفَّار» is a second khabar (predicate).

harrat-mujtaba:35-35.t: The clause «وإذ قال إبراهيم» is resumptive, and the clause «قال» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). «وبَنِيَّ»: a noun conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the yāʾ in «اجنبني», accusative (manṣūb) with the yāʾ because it is treated like a sound masculine plural, and the second yāʾ is muḍāf. [Translator's note: the source says «مضاف» here; the second yāʾ is elsewhere described in this book as «مضاف إليه».] The maṣdar «أن نعبد» is accusative by removal of the preposition «عن».

harrat-mujtaba:36-36.t: «ربِّ»: a muḍāf vocative (munādā), accusative (manṣūb) with an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the letter before the omitted first-person yāʾ. «كثيرا» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the preposition and its genitive noun «من الناس» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «كثيرا». The clause «فمن تبعني» is conjoined to the clause «إنهن أضللن»; «من» is conditional, the mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause «تبعني» is its khabar (predicate); the clause «فإنه مني» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), in the position of a jussive.

harrat-mujtaba:37-37.t: «غير» is a naʿt (adjective), «ذي» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and «عند» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a second naʿt of «واد». The second clause «ربنا» is parenthetical between the preposition and what it is attached to, because the genitive maṣdar in «ليقيموا» is attached to «أسكنت». The clause «فاجعل» is resumptive within the scope of the answer to the vocative; the clause «تهوي» is a second object, and the clause «لعلهم يشكرون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:38-38.t: The preposition and its genitive noun «على الله» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يخفى». «من شيء»: «من» is redundant (zāʾida), and «شيء» is the fāʿil (agent) of «يخفى»; the preposition and its genitive noun «في الأرض» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «شيء».

harrat-mujtaba:39-39.t: The preposition and its genitive noun «على الكبر» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the yāʾ.

harrat-mujtaba:40-40.t: «مقيم» is a second object. «ومن ذريتي»: the wāw is a conjunction, and the preposition and its genitive noun is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of the omitted element conjoined to the yāʾ in «اجعلني», i.e. "and some being of my offspring". The clause «ربنا» is parenthetical between the two conjoined elements. «دعاء» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb) with an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the letter before the omitted first-person yāʾ.

harrat-mujtaba:41-41.t: The clause «يقوم» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

harrat-mujtaba:42-42.t: The preposition and its genitive noun «عمَّا» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «غافلا»; the clause «إنما يؤخرهم» is resumptive, and the clause «تَشْخص» is a naʿt (adjective) of «يوم».

harrat-mujtaba:43-43.t: «مهطعين مقنعي»: two ḥāls (circumstantials) from the owners of the eyes; the nūn was dropped from the second ḥāl because of the annexation. The clause «لا يرتد» is a ḥāl from the pronoun in «مقنعي», and the clause «وأفئدتهم هواء» is a second ḥāl from the pronoun in «مقنعي».

harrat-mujtaba:44-44.t: «نُجب» is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), falling in the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition. «أولم تكونوا»: the hamza is for interrogation, the wāw is a conjunction, and an abrogating imperfect verb (nāsikh), jussive; the clause is the content of the speech (maqūl al-qawl) of an implied saying, and the clause of the implied saying is conjoined to the clause «يقول الذين ظلموا».

harrat-mujtaba:45-45.t: The clause «وتبيَّن» is conjoined to the clause «سكنتم». The fāʿil (agent) of «تبيَّن» is concealed, its implied form being: "their condition and their destruction"; the clause «كيف فَعَلْنا» explains the implied fāʿil, and «كيف» is an interrogative noun, a ḥāl (circumstantial).

harrat-mujtaba:46-46.t: The clause «وقد مكروا» is resumptive, and the clause «وعند الله مكرهم» is conjoined to the resumptive one. «وإن كان مكرهم»: the wāw is resumptive, «إن» is negating, and the lām in «لتزول» is the lām of denial (lām al-juḥūd); the interpreted maṣdar is genitive by the lām, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied khabar (predicate) of «كان». The clause «تزول» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle relative.

harrat-mujtaba:47-47.t: The clause «فلا تحسبن» is resumptive; «مخلف» is the second object of «تحسبن», and «رسله» is the object of «مخلف». «ذو» is a second khabar (predicate).

harrat-mujtaba:48-48.t: «يوم» is a ẓarf (adverb) attached to (mutaʿalliq) the maṣdar (verbal noun) {انْتِقَامٍ}. «غير» is the second object of «تُبَدَّل».

harrat-mujtaba:49-49.t: The clause «وترى» is conjoined to the clause {تُبَدَّلُ}; «مقرَّنين» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «المجرمين», and the preposition and its genitive noun is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «مقرنين».

harrat-mujtaba:50-50.t: The clause «سرابيلهم من قطران» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from {الْمُجْرِمِينَ}, and the clause «وتَغْشى» is conjoined to the clause «سرابيلهم من قطران».

harrat-mujtaba:52-52.t: «ولينذروا به»: the lām is causal, and an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an optionally implied «أن»; the interpreted maṣdar is genitive (majrūr), its implied form being "and for the warning", and it is conjoined to an omitted element whose implied form is «لينصحوا»; this omitted element is a genitive maṣdar attached to (mutaʿalliq) a second naʿt (adjective) of «بلاغ». The implied form is: "this is a communication to the people, being for counsel and for warning". The maṣdar «أنما هو إله» takes the place of the two objects of «علم». The maṣdar «وليعلموا» is genitive, conjoined to the preceding maṣdar.
